name: crystoline/xpsr-notifications
description: Notifications for XPSR applications: email, SMS through Symfony Notifier's providers, an in-app inbox in the database, and browser push

suggest.crystoline/xpsr-database: The database channel (an in-app inbox) and the push subscriptions of the webpush channel
suggest.crystoline/xpsr-queue: Needed for Notifier::queue(), which sends notifications from a worker
suggest.crystoline/xpsr-http-client: The HTTP client SMS providers and web push send through
suggest.minishlink/web-push: The webpush channel: browser push with VAPID keys
suggest.symfony/twilio-notifier: twilio:// SMS, and Symfony has bridges for most SMS providers, such as termii://, vonage://, and infobip://
